title: Koona list (.kpin), version 1.x
description: A shareable list of links and feeds for Koona Pin: the envelope shared by Koona apps with the payload of app "pin", kind "list". This schema is what a writer must produce; readers are more tolerant and are described in docs/kpin/README.md. Three rules of a writer cannot be written here: a file of at most 2 MB (2,097,152 bytes), at most 5,000 items across all sections and the top level, and addresses of at most 2,048 bytes in UTF-8 (maxLength counts characters). Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors. Readers ignore it.

format.description: Permanent identifier shared by every Koona app.

app.description: The app the payload is for. Koona Pin reads "pin" and names the app for any other value.

kind.description: What the file holds. Version 1 of app "pin" defines "list".

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this app and kind, as text: "1.10" is not "1.1". A newer MINOR only adds optional fields and item types; a newer MAJOR is refused by older readers.

generator.description: What wrote the file, such as "Koona Pin 2.4.0". For diagnostics only, never for behaviour.

id.description: A slug that marks the same list across its updates.

description.description: Plain text; line breaks are kept.

license.description: An SPDX license identifier, such as CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0. It covers the list itself, not the pages it links to.

language.description: The language of the list's text, as a BCP 47 tag.

updated.description: The date the list was last checked or changed, YYYY-MM-DD.

items.description: The items that are in no section.

text.description: One line of text with at least one visible character: not empty, and not only white space, control or invisible characters.

httpUrl.description: An absolute http or https address with a host. A user name or password in it is dropped by readers; writers leave them out.

url.description: The address of the RSS, Atom or JSON feed itself. Readers do not follow feeds on this computer or the local network.

unknown.description: An item type from a newer 1.x. Valid; readers that do not know it skip it and count it.
